Extraordinary space, striking architecture, and beautifully curated finishes come together at 3856 N. Kenneth. Set on a rare oversized 50' x 150' corner lot in the heart of Old Irving Park, this exceptional new-construction residence by Bakri Design & Construction offers approximately 5,853 square feet of finished living space, 6 bedrooms, and 4.5 baths. A dramatic gabled roofline and distinctive brick-and-Hardie board exterior create a home that pairs bold contemporary design with the warmth of natural materials. Ten-foot ceilings, wide hallways, select-grade 5-inch solid oak flooring, 8-foot solid-core doors, and custom cabinetry create scale and craftsmanship throughout. Thoughtfully arranged living and dining spaces, a lounge with a custom dry bar, and a dedicated first-floor office provide room to gather, entertain, and retreat. At the heart of the home, the stunning chef's kitchen features custom white oak slim-Shaker cabinetry, an impressive 11-foot island, and Audacia quartzite countertops with a full-height backsplash. A 48-inch Viking range with six burners and griddle, 48-inch Sub-Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, and microwave drawer complement the beautifully executed design. A generous walk-in pantry and separate butler's pantry with quartzite finishes, a sink, and a beverage refrigerator make hosting effortless. The kitchen opens to the welcoming family room. Just off the family room, the mudroom opens to a raised terrace finished in solid sandstone pavers. The second floor offers 4 bedrooms and a study nook, including a dreamy primary suite with a vaulted ceiling, fireplace, and private terrace overlooking the grounds. The suite also includes an expansive walk-in closet that will be custom-fitted for you and a luxurious bath with a fluted birch vanity, freestanding soaking tub, rain shower, and private water closet. Two bedrooms share a thoughtfully designed Jack-and-Jill bath, while the fourth has its own en suite bath. A spacious second-floor laundry room adds everyday convenience. The lower level offers impressive 9-foot-2-inch ceilings, an expansive family and game room with a custom wet bar, two additional bedrooms offering flexibility for guests or fitness, a full bath, a second laundry room, and abundant storage. Outside, the generous landscaped yard is an exceptional space for relaxing, playing, and entertaining. A three-car garage with two EV chargers, 4 camera-ready locations, zoned HVAC, and 400-amp electrical service further distinguish this thoughtfully appointed home. This is an incredible opportunity to enjoy expansive indoor and outdoor living in a beautiful Old Irving Park setting!
